subject: Operational continuity assurance questionnaire — Northbridge RFP
messages:
From: Maya Emerson <maya.emerson@northbridgebank.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@northbridgebank.com, oliver.grant@northbridgebank.com
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Operational continuity & audit questionnaire — Northbridge RFP

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Northbridge was impressed with the latency and the RBAC model. As part of our procurement process we need a completed Operational Continuity & Audit questionnaire (FFIEC-style controls) that covers recovery objectives, auditing evidence, and test history. I have attached our version of the questionnaire (Northbridge_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx).

Could you please return the completed form and supporting artifacts within 7 business days? Key asks:
- RTO/RPO targets and last three DR test dates
- SOC 2 Type II report and any redaction guidance
- Data retention and encryption controls (in-transit and at-rest)
- Change control and emergency patching process

If helpful, we'd like a 30–45 minute walkthrough of the answers on your calendar next week.

Thanks,
Maya Emerson
Senior Sourcing Manager | Northbridge Bank
maya.emerson@northbridgebank.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Laura / Vivek — I started a draft and put it on the shared drive: https://redwood.sharedrive.com/nb/rfp/operational-continuity (NB_RFP_Answers_Draft.docx). Highlights / open items below. I can finish SOC 2 excerpts once we confirm redaction scope.

Summary of progress:
- Section A (Governance & Ownership): complete; owner names and org chart included.
- Section B (Access & Authentication): mapped to our SSO + MFA policy; waiting on one line-item from procurement about service accounts that may be customer-managed.
- Section C (Audit & Logging): attached sample audit-log extract; need confirmation on retention windows for embeddings cache vs. request logs.
- Section D (Encryption): completed (TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest on dedicated deployments; key management via customer KMS for Private).

Open questions for Northbridge (to include in the questionnaire):
1) Do you require a full unredacted SOC 2 or is a redacted version acceptable?
2) Do you need per-tenant log exports on a standing cadence or only during audit windows?

I'll attach the draft doc to the thread for visibility.

Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 08:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Operational continuity & audit questionnaire — Northbridge RFP

Adding DR / resilience artifacts. See attached: DR_Runbook_Summary.pdf and LoadTest_Results_2025-09.csv. Quick notes:
- RTO / RPO: Hosted API: target p95 tail < 500ms for inference; DR plan aims RTO=2 hours for control plane failover, RPO=15 minutes for KV/cache warmup strategy.
- Recent tests: 2025-06-12 (partial failover), 2025-09-09 (full-scale load test, results attached), 2025-10-30 (DR tabletop).
- Runbook coverage: failover steps, DNS cutover, incremental KV warmup, traffic shaping. Runbook is a summary; full runbook is contractor-access only.
- Logs & evidence: I attached aggregated load test CSV; we can also provide Splunk excerpts on request (need a signed log-access agreement).

One procurement caveat: Northbridge asked about on-prem private deployments. If they're considering Private, we should note the KMS/HSM integration and evidence for on-site acceptance testing.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infrastructure & Reliability | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: DR_Runbook_Summary.pdf, LoadTest_Results_2025-09.csv
